newsitem.title: CANADA: Ranger sees higher Q4 North Sea output.
newsitem.headline: Ranger sees higher Q4 North Sea output.

text.p: Ranger Oil Ltd said on Thursday that it expected to increase its North Sea oil output to 35,000 barrels per day in the fourth quarter of this year.

Ranger said some of the increase, from daily third-quarter production of 23,140 barrels, would come as a result of its October acquisition of interests in the Ninian, Columba B, Hutton, Lyell and Murchison fields.
The price of the deal was US$37.7 million after adjusting for net field cash flows generated since the effective date of January 1, 1996.
Adding to the increase will be output from the first development phase of the Banff field, where production began in September.
Ranger's total oil production averaged 28,318 barrels per day in the third quarter, up from 18,904 in the same period last year.
Natural gas production averaged 165.6 million cubic feet per day in the quarter, up from 127.5 million.
All of the increase came from Ranger's North American operations, where gas production jumped to 151.6 million cubic feet per day from 105.4 million. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
